The real deficits are internal: activation -6% QoQ and onboarding completion -4% QoQ. Between the two friction levers, memory_91 (in-product activation messaging) addresses the larger gap and, critically, does not change who enters the funnel, so it carries no qualification-dilution risk. memory_86/memory_31 (shortening onboarding, cutting required fields) improved completion and first-week activation, but both records as summarized measure funnel-stage metrics, not downstream retention or revenue quality — removing required fields can lift activation while degrading routing, qualification, and eventual renewal, exactly the pattern memory_73 makes visible when the downstream metric is actually tracked.
